answer: In PoA, each challenge is derived from an agent commitment and a future drand quicknet threshold-BLS beacon pulse, revealed only after the commit window closes. Since the pulse is unpredictable beforehand and not controllable by any single participant, a sybil swarm cannot pre-compute responses, farm an offline answer library, or discard unfavorable assignments. Every wander, relic, or whisper identity must therefore produce fresh, beacon-bound work.
